description: This file defines a controller class SaveQualificationLicenseController for the OrangeHRM system, responsible for handling license qualification save operations within the admin plugin. It extends a base Vue controller and manages rendering components based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveQualificationLicenseController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering license-related Vue components based on request data within the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered; chooses between 'license-edit' and 'license-save' based on presence of 'id' in request attributes.
